attempts.summary: Configured node1 to run /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15 via root's crontab, appending output to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. The script file was found broken (contained leftover heredoc/setup artifacts instead of valid shell) and was rewritten to a correct, executable printf-based script. Verified the cron entry, script execution, and log append behavior before and after a full node1 reboot, confirming persistence via a changed boot_id.
